question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Ivanhoe, Bob gets Dune, Claire gets Emma, Dave gets Jane Eyre, and Eve gets Hamlet.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Eve and Dave swap books. Then, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Eve and Alice swap books. Then, Claire and Dave swap books. Finally, Bob and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Ivanhoe
(B) Dune
(C) Emma
(D) Jane Eyre
(E) Hamlet
solution:
Each row lists the books held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve, in that order.
Initial: Ivanhoe | Dune | Emma | Jane Eyre | Hamlet
After Eve–Dave: Ivanhoe | Dune | Emma | Hamlet | Jane Eyre
After Alice–Claire: Emma | Dune | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | Jane Eyre
After Eve–Alice: Jane Eyre | Dune | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | Emma
After Claire–Dave: Jane Eyre | Dune | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Emma
After Bob–Claire: Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Dune | Ivanhoe | Emma
Bob has Hamlet, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
